tests.name: 4930火土印记实际红伤免疫归零触发，已有同种全场印记不新增种类；仅盾抵挡与MISS不触发
tests.assertion: test('4930火土印记实际红伤免疫归零触发，已有同种全场印记不新增种类；仅盾抵挡与MISS不触发',()=>{const s=partialMake({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,1,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土.end,5);for(const mode of['shield','miss']){const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(p.fighters[1],9000,'test');else timer(p,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土,undefined);}const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1});timer(p,1,'攻击伤害免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(p,38485,20117),/Q-4930-001/);});

tests.name: 4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫
tests.assertion: test('4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫',()=>{for(const chances of[[55,18],[50,50],[0,0]]){const s=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[{name:'中毒',chance:chances[0]},{name:'烧伤',chance:chances[1]},{name:'',chance:0}];assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'中毒'),chances[0]>chances[1]?1:chances[0]/100);assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'烧伤'),chances[1]/100);}const s=make({move:38485,index:1}),z=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});timer(z,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});turn(s,38485,20117);turn(z,38485,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(z));const p=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(p,0,'火土');timer(p,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(p),0);});

tests.assertion: test('4930/2528真实击败登记，准备好的次轮结算按净回血附伤且技能禁疗/满血为零，属性招不消费',()=>{const ko=make({...row(2528),targetHp:1});turn(ko,ko.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(ko.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(ko.fighters[0].soulState.emperorRecovery2528.round,2);for(const mode of['normal','ban','full']){const s=make({move:29419,index:-1,hp:mode==='full'?9000:8000});s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorRecovery2528={round:1,fraction:1,extra:1,sourceMove:38485,sourceHash:'fc1fac18'};if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,29419,20117);const n=mode==='normal'?1000:0;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?8000:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorExtra2528.amount,n);s.moveDefinitions[key(38483)].operations=[];turn(s,38483,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorExtra2528,undefined);}});
